parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

normal: Plaintext without encryption.

sm2: SM2 encryption
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式：

normal：明文不加密。

sm2：SM2加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

If paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext ID card number.

If paramType is set to sm2, enter the ciphertext ID card number.


Due to authoritative source limitations, only the ID card numbers of the second-generation resident identity cards are supported
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号。

paramType传入 normal 时：输入身份证号明文。

paramType 传入 sm2 时：输入身份证号密文。


受权威源影响，仅支持二代居民身份证的证件号码
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The name.

If paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext name.

If paramType is set to sm2, enter the ciphertext name
parameters.help_zh:
姓名。

paramType 传入 normal 时：输入姓名明文。

paramType 传入 sm2 时：输入姓名密文
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face photo. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 人脸照片，地址需为公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: face_url

parameters.example: 具体接入方式，请参见文件上传 Advance 接口配置。
parameters.help_en: The input stream of the face photo
parameters.name: face_file

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow cropping the face image. By default, cropping is not allowed.
T: Cropping is allowed.
F: Cropping is not allowed.
If the requested image is not collected by the standard liveness detection SDK, we recommend that you allow face image cropping.
After this feature is enabled, the requested image is cropped and corrected before the request is processed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许裁剪人脸图片，默认不允许。
T：表示允许剪裁。
F：表示不允许剪裁。
若您请求的图片并非来自标准活体检测SDK采集，建议您允许裁剪人脸图片。
开启该功能后，将会对请求的图片先进行人脸裁剪与矫正，完成后会发起请求服务
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the photo. If you use this method to pass the face photo, check the photo size and do not pass an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 照片Base64编码。若选择此方式传入人脸照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: face_picture

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable liveness detection. Valid values:

N (default): Liveness detection is disabled.
Y: Liveness detection is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启活体检测，取值：

N（默认）：关闭活体检测。
Y：开启活体检测
parameters.name: liveness_check

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow fallback to non-public security sources. Valid values:

N (default): Disabled.
Y: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许非公安源兜底：

N（默认）：关闭。
Y：开启
parameters.name: enable_fallback

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the API call is successful
Code.description_zh: 返回码，200表示接口响应成功

Message.description_en:
The message returned for the API call.
<notice>This parameter only indicates whether an exception occurs during the API call.></notice>
Message.description_zh:
接口调用返回信息。
<notice>此参数仅表示接口是否异常。></notice>

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result from the authoritative source. Valid values:

1: Consistent (billed).
2: Inconsistent (billed).
3: No record found (not billed)
BizCode.description_zh:
权威源核验结果。

1：校验⼀致（计费）
2：校验不⼀致（计费）
3：查⽆记录（不计费）

FaceDetail.description_en:
verifyScore: The face comparison score. Valid values: 0 to 1000. A higher score indicates a higher probability that the faces belong to the same person. A score of 700.0 or higher confirms that the faces belong to the same person.

faceAttack: Returned when liveness detection is enabled. This value does not affect the verification result.

invokeChannel: The identifier of the actual invocation channel. Valid values:
1: Authoritative source. 0: Comprehensive source
FaceDetail.description_zh:
verifyScore：人像对比分值，取值范围：0～1000，分值越大，相同人脸概率越高，>=700.0确认为同一人。

faceAttack：开启活体检测时返回（不参与核验结果决策）。

invokeChannel：实际调用渠道标识符：
1：权威源；0综合源

HitWhitelist.description_en: Indicates whether the whitelist is hit. Valid value: Y

SubCode.description_en:
The verification details from the authoritative source. Valid values:

101: Authentication passed.

201: Authentication failed. The name does not match the ID card number.

202: Authentication failed. The person is suspected to be the ID owner.

203: Authentication failed. No photo is found in the database.

204: Authentication failed. The faces do not belong to the same person.

205: Authentication failed. Image modeling for the image to be compared failed.

206: Authentication failed. The image format is incorrect.

207: Authentication failed. The uploaded image is too small. Upload another image.

208: Authentication failed. The quality of the uploaded face photo is poor. Upload another photo.

301: No record found. The ID card number does not exist in the database.

302: No record found. Verification cannot be performed
SubCode.description_zh:
权威源核验详情：

101：认证通过

201：认证不通过，姓名与身份证号不匹配

202：认证不通过，疑似本人

203：认证不通过，库中无照片

204：认证不通过，非同一人

205：认证不通过，待比对图像建模失败

206：认证不通过，图片格式不正确

207：认证不通过，上传图片太小，请重新上传

208：认证不通过，上传的人像照片质量不佳，请重新上传

301：查无记录，库中无此号

302：查无记录，无法验证
